lines.say: My mom is a hairdresser, and a single mother of seven.
Seven kids. One chair. Zero room for a slow week.
That chair paid for food, clothes, and everything in between.
Including seven pairs of shoes, which they all outgrow overnight.
Then I noticed something. Some of her regulars were disappearing.
Nobody complained. Nobody said goodbye. Life just got busy, and they drifted.
By the time she noticed, the chair had been empty for months.
The only thing still booking was dust.
And every one of those clients was money our family was counting on.
So I looked at the tools that already existed. A separate subscription for everything. And each one wanted a kidney.
caps: So I looked at the tools

lines.say: I have two. But I was kind of attached to them.
That software was built for businesses with marketing budgets. Not for a mom with a chair.
What I did have was a love of building things. I got that from her.
So I built it myself. I was a sophomore in high school.
caps: I was a *sophomore* in high school.

lines.say: My biggest problem that week was algebra. Now it was customer churn. And yes, the homework was still due.
And it worked. She could finally see who was slipping away, and win them back with one simple message.
That's the name. Message Health.
Every client relationship has a pulse. How often they book. How long since their last visit. Whether they still answer your texts.
When it fades, it happens quietly. No alarms. No dramatic hospital beep. Just silence.
But the right message, at the right time, brings it right back. A simple, we miss you, beats any ad.
Then I realized this wasn't just about salons.
Barbers. Spas. Gyms. Cleaners. Even plumbers. Yes, the leak experts have a leak.
caps: Yes, the leak experts have a *leak.*

lines.say: Customers don't leave with a goodbye. They just stop coming back. Rude, honestly.
So in twenty twenty-six, I opened Message Health to everyone.
Every feature is still built for her. A hardworking owner, with no time to spare, who can't afford to lose a single client.
If that sounds like you, Message Health was made for you too.
Message Health dot net.
